method: W371 per package/artifacts/spec.md: weights cycle 3,7,1 assigned to the payload digits from RIGHT to LEFT, with the rightmost payload digit receiving weight 3 (so a 7-digit payload has left-to-right weights 3,1,7,3,1,7,3 and a 6-digit payload has 1,7,3,1,7,3). S is the sum of digit x weight over the payload; the check digit is (10 - (S mod 10)) mod 10. For 'validate' items the identifier's final digit is the claimed check digit and the payload is everything before it; the identifier is VALID iff that final digit equals the computed check digit. For 'compute' items the listed string is the whole payload and the answer is its computed check digit. Full per-item weighted-sum tables are recorded in derivations.md. An in-session read-only cross-check re-derived every item by the congruence form (identifier valid iff S + final digit is congruent to 0 mod 10, with independently re-tabulated right-to-left sums) and agreed on all 12 items; a causally separate disjoint re-derivation (evidence requirement E-B) is assigned to the root-executed verify-independent examiner per examiner-charge.md.
